name: Self
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject worldly conformity and instead be transformed by renewing their minds, aligning with God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). This transformation involves humility, as believers are urged not to think of themselves more highly than they ought but to maintain sober judgment according to the faith God has given (Romans 12:3). Christ-centered humility further encourages esteeming others above oneself, avoiding strife and vain glory (Philippians 2:3). Strength for living this self-denying life comes through Christ, who empowers believers to overcome challenges and grow in godliness (Philippians 4:13).
